prompt_preview:
Decide whether the proposal deck addresses the client requirement below.

STATUS (choose exactly one):
- "Covered": the slides commit to ALL parts of the requirement. Different wording is fine.
- "Partially covered": the slides commit to SOME parts, but at least one part is missing.
- "Not covered":

response.evidence: Prioritized sequence of initiatives for future implementation.
response.missing: Cost-benefit estimate for every proposed initiative
response.reasoning: Slide 11 commits to a prioritized sequence of initiatives, but the slides do not provide any cost-benefit estimate for each proposed initiative.
